description.value:
If you use Boundless Vitality while concentrating on a force power, you can apply that roll's result as a bonus to the Constitution saving throw you make to keep your concentration.

In addition, if Upheld by the Force is active when you're reduced to 0 hit points without being killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead. Once used, this second benefit requires a long rest before it can trigger again.
